info.name: JANMITRA — Nagpur Municipal Corporation API Collection
info.description:
Audited and verified Postman API Collection (v2.1.0) for the JANMITRA Civic Complaint Management System (Nagpur Municipal Corporation).

### Features & Security:
- Automated Bearer JWT Injection via collection pre-request script
- Genuine public routes (health, login, register, refresh, public meta) bypass auth headers
- Safe JWT token persistence on login and refresh (never overwrites valid tokens on failure)
- Full multipart/form-data support for civic complaint submission and worker proof-of-work
- Specific assertion tests validating status codes, response structures, and error responses
- Complete coverage across Citizen, Field Worker, Department Officer, and Municipal Administrator roles
